title.narrative: Enhance Youth Involvement in the Protection of Tangible Heritage

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen Namibia’s efforts to safeguard and promote its cultural and natural heritage by advancing the nomination of heritage sites on the UNESCO World Heritage List and strengthening national heritage management capacities. Building on ongoing collaborations with heritage institutions and tertiary institutions, the initiative will support student-led and institutional research on sites currently included on Namibia’s UNESCO Tentative List to generate the knowledge and documentation required for robust World Heritage nomination dossiers. The project will also enhance national capacity for the protection, conservation, safeguarding, and promotion of both tangible and intangible cultural heritage through research, knowledge generation, and stakeholder engagement.
In addition, the project will support follow-up actions related to the proposed Transboundary Okavango Delta World Heritage Extension, including the organization of the Tripartite Steering Committee meeting and the implementation of recommendations arising from community consultations. Through these interventions, the project will contribute to increasing Namibia’s representation on UNESCO heritage lists while promoting community participation, heritage conservation, and sustainable development.
Key Activities 1. Collaborate with heritage institutions and universities to conduct student-led research projects on heritage sites on the UNESCO tentative lists, to accelerate the inscription of heritage sites on the UNESCO World Heritage listing. 2. National Capacity Building Workshops on, process of developing World Heritage nomination dossiers, inventorying of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) and best practices for protection and conservation. 3. Coordinate the participation of Namibia in the tripartite steering Committee meeting.
